name: Comet Dial
description: Circular rotary dial slider drawn in SVG. Dragging or flicking the arc moves the value with spring physics, and a fading comet tail stretches behind the handle in proportion to speed.
contents: SVG slider with background arc, lit progress arc, round head handle
12-segment comet tail that grows with drag velocity
behavior: Drag or tap on the arc to set the value, with spring settling and optional bounce
Flick on release carries momentum before snapping to the step
Comet tail length, width and opacity scale with value velocity
Keyboard control with arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home and End (Shift for x10)
Works controlled via value or uncontrolled via defaultValue
Reduced motion preference makes value changes jump with no tail
editableByProps: Value range, step, unit and accessible label
Accent and ink colors, dial size, arc sweep angle and stroke thickness
Spring speed, tap and flick bounce, momentum
Disabled state, change callbacks, extra class name

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of comet tail segments
Change the size of the dead zone in the center that ignores input
Change how far a pointer must move before a tap becomes a drag
Change the arc radius within the viewBox
Change readout font size or style
needsCodeEdit.where: --cd-figure style and the span with ref figure in the returned JSX

fixed: Marked use client, needs a client-rendered React environment
Adds window pointermove, pointerup and pointercancel listeners during a drag and removes them after
Runs its own requestAnimationFrame loop while moving
Ignores synthetic events (only trusted pointer events count) and clicks within the central dead zone
Arc starts at the bottom and the gap is centered at the bottom
Square layout using the size prop, text color comes from ink
Dark-friendly default colors are near white, so it needs a dark background
